item.title: Investigation Leads to Drug Seizure and Arrest in Austin County
item.description: A year-long Westside Narcotics Task Force investigation in Austin County resulted in six arrests, the seizure of large quantities of cocaine and methamphetamine, and an estimated $400,000–$650,000 in street value drugs.

item.title: Governor Abbott Urges Texans To Follow Mexico Travel Warnings
item.description: Governor Greg Abbott is urging Texans to follow U.S. Department of State travel warnings amid escalating violence and security operations in parts of Mexico.

item.title: Shiner Expands Legacy with Launch of Shiner Bock Non-Alcoholic
item.description: Shiner introduces Shiner Bock Non-Alcoholic, expanding its 116-year brewing legacy with an alcohol-free version of its iconic Texas flagship beer.

item.title: Firefighters Attend Bellville Fireground Training
item.description: Dozens of regional firefighters gathered in Bellville for hands-on training focused on improving water flow tactics, reducing fatigue, and responding effectively with limited manpower.
